prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Trait Personality Quiz Screen: Adds a quick pet personality trait quiz screen right before photo customization to match users with pet companion behaviors. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion or issues during pet customization, while adoption step mean duration is 1017s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step: Moves the sign-in requirement until after the user finalizes their pet adoption certificate and names their pet. (why: Signing in before pet creation causes early drop-off; placing sign-in after certificate creation leverages psychological ownership.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore & Sync Assurance Banner: Adds an explicit account synchronization notice explaining how previously created pets are restored automatically. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account reset after signing in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Safety Diagnostic & Progress Waiting Indicator: Displays an active system verification checklist and estimated countdown on the waiting screen. (why: 3 support complaints mentioned the app failing to open or pet not showing on desktop, plus high waiting time.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls & Interaction Quick Reference Headline: Updates the final intro screen copy to provide a quick guide on system tray controls, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Audio Alert & System Notification Toggle: Adds an optional sound notification and system alert toggle when rendering finishes on the desktop background. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; users switch tasks while waiting and miss when the pet spawns.)

scores.note: Targeted step has long duration (1017s) and 25.3% drop, but adding a quiz screen requires a release.
Delaying sign-in leverages ownership, but reordering steps requires structural release.
Strong evidence from 8 support complaints regarding missing pet sync at sign-in.
High wait time (2336s) causes drop-off; clear progress indicators mitigate drop.
Finish step has the highest drop rate (28.3%); quick copy-only fix makes cost very low.
Addresses task-switching during 2336s wait time, but notification integration requires code release.
